destination.name: Jiangshan
destination.tagline: Danxia sandstone peaks, a clan village and a stone-paved pass in south-west Zhejiang
destination.description: Jiangshan is a county-level city in south-west Zhejiang and the base for Mount Jianglang, three sandstone peaks in a line that are part of China Danxia World Heritage. Nearby Qingyang Village is the ancestral village of the Jiangnan Mao clan, with a clan ancestral hall. The Xianxia ancient road climbs through four gates on about five km of stone-paved path.

goodToKnow.title: Expect a steep climb
goodToKnow.detail: Mount Jianglang's peaks are a sandstone climb. Start early and bring water.

goodToKnow.title: Sights are spread out
goodToKnow.detail: The peaks, village and pass are separate stops, so a taxi or hired driver from Jiangshan town helps.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Jiangshan is best in {months}, when clear, cooler days make the long climbs comfortable.
